name: Power Plant (Empyrean ruin)
title: Power Plant
summary: A large Empyrean ruin in the Tiofor Woods dubbed 'the Power Plant' by early explorers (AC Explorer's 'Shadow Castle'), home to Shadows. In the kit it is a 72 x 96 m temple complex in a forest clearing (z 64): a central octagon hall with a spire roof (top z 78.7) ringed by twelve moss-green ranges of three to six storeys (tops z 74-89.5), a two-storey hall with a portico of eight stone columns north of the octagon, all surrounded by 20-40 m forest trees and a hill rising 50 m to the south-east.

site.name: Power Plant (Empyrean ruin)
site.notes: No outdoor gazetteer teleport (the gazetteer power-plant entry is a map @tele to the wrong place); derived @teleloc on the open forest-floor clearing 36 m east of the ruin's east range (ground z 64.0, nearest scenery 5.4 m).

shots.standingOrder: Hang over the Tiofor treetops south-east of the ruin looking straight down at the canopy, then tilt up to reveal the Empyrean temple complex in its clearing; climb rather than touch any crown.
shots.notes: Opener: hovering 90 m above the ruin's base (~55 m over the forested south-east hill, 40 m clear of the nearest crown) looking almost straight down at the Tiofor Woods canopy, then tilting up from -80 to -24 deg while drifting 10 m: the Empyrean temple complex - octagon spire hall ringed by twelve moss-green four- to six-storey ranges - appears in its clearing at t~4 and settles below frame centre. Sun SE (0.43) behind-left of the lens. A reveal: the subject is out of frame for the first ~4 s by design (edit window starts at 3.5 s). Verified (check.mjs, full take flown): take 0-10 s: AGL 53.38..55.9 m, nearest drawn 40.44 m (scenery-default 0x020002D3@26815,33642), vmax 1.57 m/s, LOS blocked 0/41, subject in frame 59%; edit 3.5-10 s: AGL 54.05..55.9 m, nearest drawn 40.44 m (scenery-default 0x020002D3@26815,33642), vmax 1.57 m/s, LOS blocked 0/27, subject in frame 89%; flight cinema peak 1.57 m/s (cap 12), max tracking gap 0.01 m.

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up the open lane between the moss-green hall and the east range, facing the octagon spire hall, until the whole temple complex and the forest beyond spread out below; keep 6 m from every wall.
shots.notes: Boom rise from 2.5 m to 30 m straight up the 21 m-wide open lane between the moss-green two-storey hall and the east range (NNE of the octagon), gimbal level-tracking the octagon spire hall: walls slide down past the lens until the whole temple complex and the forested hills spread out below. Clearance: 8 m to the nearest object (an invisible camp generator box), every wall >= 8 m. Verified (check.mjs, full take flown): take 0-10 s: AGL 2.5..30 m, nearest drawn 8.22 m (spawn Banderling Berserker Camp Generator), vmax 4.32 m/s, LOS blocked 0/41, subject in frame 100%; edit 2.5-9 s: AGL 6.53..29.3 m, nearest drawn 8.76 m (spawn Banderling Berserker Camp Generator), vmax 4.32 m/s, LOS blocked 0/27, subject in frame 100%; flight cinema peak 4.31 m/s (cap 12), max tracking gap 0.04 m; opt-in retail-bake tree 5.6 m (not drawn by the default bake the film uses - keep ?sceneryBake default).

shots.standingOrder: Orbit the ruin counter-clockwise 110 m out and 70 m up while the sky clock races and the shadows swing round the octagon spire; stay 12 m above every tree crown.
shots.notes: Hyperlapse orbit: 0.105 turn counter-clockwise from ESE, 110 m out and 70 m above the ruin base (41-67 m above the hill and forest), while the sky clock runs 120x (~0.16 game-day over the take, sun stays up from 0.43 to ~0.59): clouds race and the shadows of the six-storey ranges swing across the courtyard.
